answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can trade, and slash that bond whenever a peer audit proves two identities share one operator. A sybil farm then pays per puppet: a thousand fake accounts means a thousand locked bonds, and each detected puppet forfeits its stake, so cloning stops paying. Like a lantern on a dark island, the bond lights up who is really present, keeping the marketplace a haven where reputation is earned rather than copied.
